【一架美国空军C-17“环球霸王III”运输机降落在莫斯科伏努科沃机场】
目击者拍摄的视频显示，一架美国空军C-17“环球霸王III”运输机从拉脱维亚里加起飞后降落在莫斯科伏努科沃机场。
克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫随后否认他掌握任何关于这架飞机的信息……
未经证实的报道称，此次任务可能与美国国防部长赫格塞斯即将进行的访问有关。
C-17运输机通常用于在高级官员出行前运送人员、车辆和设备，但也用于赫格塞斯执行敏感或未公开的任务。
这架飞机从拉脱维亚里加直飞，于格林尼治标准时间07:00左右降落在莫斯科。
这架飞机于周五从位于华盛顿特区附近的安德鲁斯联合基地抵达里加。
目前尚不清楚它是否载有货物或乘客。
今年1月，美国注册的喷气式飞机最后一次从欧洲直飞俄罗斯，当时搭载了特使维特科夫和库什纳。
关于这架飞机，还有很多疑问尚未解答……俄乌战争快结束了？

Eyewitness video shows a US Air Force C-17 Globemaster III landing at Moscow’s Vnukovo Airport after flying from Riga, Latvia.
The U.S. landed a C-17 Globemaster III transport plane at Moscow's Vnukovo Airport today.
Kremlin spox. Dmitry Peskov has since DENIED he has any info on the plane...
Unconfirmed reports indicate the mission may be connected to an upcoming trip by Sec. Hegseth.
While the C-17 is often used to move personnel, vehicles, and equipment ahead of senior-level travel, it’s also used as transportation for Hegseth on sensitive or unannounced missions.
The plane had flown direct from Riga, Latvia, and landed in Moscow at around 0700 ⁠GMT.
It arrived in Riga on Friday from Joint Base Andrews, near Washington, D.C.
It is unclear whether it carried any cargo or passengers.
The last direct flight of a U.S.-registered ⁠jet to Russia from Europe took place in January of this year, carrying special envoys Witkoff and Kushner.
Lots of unanswered questions on this one...
